claim: When VPC Resolver evaluates whether a private hosted zone matches the domain name in a request, a match is either an identical match or a zone whose name is a parent of the domain name in the request.

evidence.quote: VPC Resolver evaluates whether the name of the private hosted zone matches the domain name in the request, such as accounting.example.com. A match is defined as either of the following: An identical match The name of the private hosted zone is a parent of the domain name in the request.
